# Southern California Well Service
# Website: https://scwellservice.com
# Contact: (760) 440-8520

## About
Southern California Well Service is a family-owned water well drilling and pump repair company serving San Diego, Riverside, and San Bernardino Counties. Founded in 2020 by Brighton and Travis Sego, we bring over 60 years of combined family heritage in well drilling.

## Services
- Water Well Drilling (residential, agricultural, commercial)
- Pump Repair & Replacement
- Well Maintenance & Inspections
- Emergency 24/7 Service
- Pressure Tank Installation
- Water Testing

## Service Areas
San Diego County: Ramona, Valley Center, Escondido, Poway, Alpine, Jamul, Julian, Fallbrook, El Cajon, Lakeside
Riverside County: Temecula, Murrieta, Hemet, Anza, Aguanga, Winchester, Menifee, Perris
San Bernardino County: Yucaipa, Redlands, Highland, Oak Glen, Cherry Valley, Calimesa, Beaumont

## Locations
